thread:
Ivy: hey all - Ivy here, first day in Eng-ML. I'm trying to assemble a super short "who-to-ping" for week zero: doors/badge, dev GCP access, prod IAM, model-serving runbook walkthrough, Dedicated customer SLA escalations, and hardware/GPU requests. who owns each lane?

ops-bot: welcome @Ivy :tada: New hire checklist: https://redwood.internal/newhire. For access use https://redwood.internal/forms/access-request.

Ben: welcome! Quick owners: badge -> facilities (cc people-ops), dev GCP -> eng-infra (I handle most approvals), prod IAM -> eng-sre (Tara owns prod IAM scopes), runbooks -> eng-runtime team owns docs and oncall, Dedicated customer escalations -> support-leads + solutions.

Tara: confirm prod IAM and service-account reviews are under eng-sre. For emergency prod changes, tag `@eng-sre-oncall` and put "prod-impact" in the subject. We'll require an outage postmortem if perms caused customer impact.

Sam: model-serving runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-serving.md has a 10-min triage and rollback steps. Oncall is `@eng-runtime-oncall`. If it's a Dedicated customer SLA, also notify `#support-escalations` and include customer org-id + incident severity.

Ivy: good call. for hardware/GPU procurement who do I file with and what's the lead time?

Ben: file GPU/hardware asks in `#eng-infra-hardware` with spec, intended model, and justification. Typical procurement lead time is 4-6 weeks for new orders; for urgent swaps we have a small spare pool (request via `#eng-infra` and tag me).

Ivy: and contractors or short-term VPN access?

Tara: contractor VPN -> access request form with expiry, cc your manager and `@eng-infra`. We require a manager approval in the ticket. If it stalls past 48h ping `@Tara` and I'll chase.

Ivy: awesome. any short ladder so I don't cross-post during a pager?

Sam: ladder we use: 1) Serving/latency/response errors -> `#eng-runtime` + `@eng-runtime-oncall`. 2) Infra/permissions/provisioning -> `#eng-infra` + `@eng-infra-oncall`. 3) Customer impact/SLAs -> `#support-escalations` + `@support-leads`. 4) Security incidents -> `#eng-security` + `@sec-oncall`. If multiple areas affected start in `#incident-coord`.

Ben: I'll add this matrix to the new-hire doc and paste a one-line "who to CC" table.

Ivy: perfect, thanks y'all. I'll start the access form and ping if anything blocks. :pray:
